metadata.description: Antigravity plugin for Claude Code: deep web research with citations, code rescue, task delegation, and browser walkthrough recording via Google Antigravity CLI (agy / Gemini 3.x). The modern successor to gemini-plugin-cc — no Node.js runtime, just four slash commands and a thin Bash forwarder.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Four slash commands wrapping Google Antigravity CLI (agy): /agy:research for deep web research at low/medium/high intensity with citations saved to docs/agy/research/, /agy:rescue for code/diagnosis task delegation, /agy:record for browser walkthrough recording (.webm + optional MP4 via ffmpeg) saved to docs/agy/recordings/, /agy:setup for health checks. Thin Bash forwarder, no runtime dependencies.
